recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Do not recreate the old CDS Hooks or ComputablePlanDefinition profile guidance in core; update the Using FHIR Clinical Reasoning with CDS Hooks IG or CRMI for future corrections unless a new CDS/FM group decision explicitly brings that content back into base FHIR.
issue_request: FHIR-18844 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked for implementation-guide-style documentation for using logical reasoning resources with CDS Hooks and CQL-based reasoning engines. The accepted resolution was to expand Clinical Reasoning documentation for PlanDefinitions computable using CQL libraries to support CDS Hooks service evaluation, refer to CDSHooksPlanDefinition and ComputablePlanDefinition, and clarify that ComputablePlanDefinition is orthogonal rather than required.
initial_application: Jira-tagged commits 1c7aa38e3e and 60a763e7ca originally applied the issue in source/clinicalreasoning-cds-on-fhir.html by expanding CDS Hooks service and PlanDefinition mapping guidance and adding references to the then-core CDS Hooks service and Computable PlanDefinition profiles.
additional_context: Later applied CDS work changed the correct current shape. FHIR-53085 moved most CDS-on-FHIR page content, CDS Hooks PlanDefinition/RequestOrchestration profiles, and supporting concept maps to the Using FHIR Clinical Reasoning with CDS Hooks IG. FHIR-48393 and the related FHIR-18845 audit establish that ComputablePlanDefinition and other computable/shareable/publishable profiles moved out of base FHIR, with current guidance directing applications to CRMI. Active core Clinical Reasoning pages now keep high-level PlanDefinition/$apply and CDS Hooks guidance and link to the external IGs that own detailed conformance material.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing old core profile references or duplicating detailed CDS Hooks/CQL mapping prose in core would conflict with later applied decisions. The current source already gives implementers the correct high-level relationship and maintained external references.
